messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT alert — service: inference-runtime, severity: P1. symptom: container restart loop on gpu-node-47 due to CUDA OOM during prefill. thread created 9101010101
amanda: paging @oncall-ryan — seen spikes in prefill token growth, containers restarting 1-2x/min on pool long-context-1.
ryan: on it. pulling logs now.
raj: observed kvcache allocate ballooning to ~48GB during prefill for a few requests with ~150k-200k tokens. GC doesn't reclaim in time, container hits OOM and restarts.
sasha: can we abort prefill when token_count > 50k? that's where growth explodes in our traces.
amanda: temporary mitigation: set MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS=50000 on pool config and roll 2 replicas to drain inflight long requests.
ryan: rolling config via deploy CLI — will route new requests away. applying now.
ops-bot: Deploy started by ryan: /deploy apply prefconfig long-context-1 MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS=50000
ryan: applied to 2/3 nodes, holding on third (hot restart loop). forcing drain of node-47 and moving traffic to long-context-2.
raj: on node-47 stacktrace shows `cudaErrorOutOfMemory` in allocLargeKV() and repeated `cuMemAlloc` failures, suspect fragmented VRAM + delayed eviction reclaim.
sasha: suggestion: enable early-prefill trimming — if prefill > 40k trim oldest context blocks so kvcache stays <=32GB. also consider CPU fallback for extreme requests.
amanda: customers impacted: 2 high-volume tenants saw degraded latency and 503s for prefill-heavy routes. Support notified.
elena: sent initial customer note: "We're investigating transient restarts for long-context requests. Mitigations in progress; ETA ~30m."
ryan: monitoring metrics — prefill failure rate down ~80% after config change. node-47 still crashy, need deeper remediation.
raj: collecting coredump + NVML logs, opening infra ticket. snippet: `kubectl describe pod runtime-abc`, `nvidia-smi` shows mem fragmented across processes.
ops-bot: infra ticket opened: INFRA-1234 assigned to gpu-team. @infra-team
sasha: propose hotpatch: runtime early-prefill-trim + config guardrail to reject prefill requests > 100k tokens with explicit consent. low-risk canary first.
amanda: canary plan approved — enable on pool-long-context-2 for 15m before wider rollout.
ryan: pushing hotpatch to canary: `kubectl set env daemonset/runtime HOTPREFILL_TRIM=1 TRIM_THRESHOLD=40000`
ops-bot: hotpatch deployed to canary by ryan.
raj: canary stable for 12m, no restarts there. node-47 remains unhealthy; will repro in staging with synthetic 150k-token prefill to validate fixes.
elena: customer update sent: "We applied mitigations and are canarying a fix. We'll follow up once node remediation completes."
amanda: post-incident action items: 1) runtime: implement early-prefill trimming and prefill quota enforcement, 2) infra: investigate GPU memory fragmentation root cause on node-47 + firmware/drivers, 3) product: default rate-limit for very large prefill requests and update docs.
ryan: moving to monitoring watch. will hand off oncall to raj in 30m if stable.
ops-bot: Incident status: mitigation in place (partial). No global outage. last update 9101010230
